sources.title: ATmega328P DC characteristics
sources.ref: DS40002061: VIL max 0.3*Vcc, VIH min 0.6*Vcc, VOL max 0.9 V at 0.020 A, VOH min 4.2 V at -0.020 A, Vcc abs-max 6.0 V. Pins PB0-PB7, PC0-PC6, PD0-PD7, VCC, AVCC, AREF, GND, RESET

sources.title: ATmega328P 16 MHz speed grade
sources.ref: DS40002061 Figure 33-1, Maximum Frequency vs. VCC. On the 2.7 V / 10 MHz to 4.5 V / 20 MHz segment, 16 MHz needs 3.78 V, so a running chip between the brownout level and 3.78 V is outside its specification (minOperatingVoltage). Electrical characteristics list VCC up to 5.5 V

sources.title: ATmega328P reset
sources.ref: DS40002061 V_RST maximum 0.9 * VCC: RESET can be recognised as low up to that fraction (resetFraction). The rail is 5 V (railVoltage)

sources.title: ATmega328P pin
sources.ref: DS40002061 Figure 35-22 and Figure 35-24 at 25 C and VCC 5 V: Roh and Rol are the fitted resistances. Rpu is the midpoint of 20 kohm to 50 kohm. Input leakage is Iin 1 uA at 5 V, a 5 Mohm path to ground

sources.title: ATmega328P brownout
sources.ref: DS40002061 Table 29-1 with BODLEVEL 2.7 V (extended fuse 0xFD): threshold 2.7 V, hysteresis 25 mV either side. Reset hold is the 66 ms start-up time
